Install with `npm install -D tsc-rs`, use it as the `typescript` package with `"typescript": "npm:@tsc-rs/typescript@0.8.0"` in package.json, or download the archive for your platform.

## What's Changed
* feat: @tsc-rs/typescript drop-in package; faster incremental noEmit runs by @t3dotgg in https://github.com/pingdotgg/ts-rust/pull/96


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pingdotgg/ts-rust/co
